snippet.title: Diablo IV | Season of Slaughter Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s time for you to embrace your inner demons. 😈

🔪 Become The Butcher
💥 New Killstreak Mechanic
🛡️ Try the Paladin in the Free Trial
🔥 Earn DOOM items through the free Reliquary 

The Season of Slaughter arrives in Diablo IV on March 11.
